job.name: ig15_host_a
job.meaning: мужчина ~58, седые волосы назад, короткая седая борода, белое поло, тёмные джинсы, кремовое кожаное кресло частного самолёта, иллюминатор, дерево
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm wealthy Russian man about 58, swept-back silver hair, short neat grey beard, tanned, a white pique polo shirt, dark blue jeans, a steel wristwatch. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium shot from mid-thigh up, he sits relaxed in a cream leather seat of a private jet cabin, slightly turned to the camera, both shoulders and hands inside the frame, a smartphone lying face down on the polished walnut side table, his face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, one hand in a calm open gesture, calm confident kind expression, NO broad smile. Background: private jet interior with oval windows, soft daylight, walnut wood panels, cream leather. Look: a real frame from a phone camera on a tripod, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.

attempts.issue: distorted fingers on the gesturing hand
